**Finding submitted: deviation (LOL-CAP).**

- **Cap mechanics are fine.** §§ 9.1 and 9.2 mirror each other — each party is liable for no more than the greater of $100,000 or 12 months' charges paid, plus indemnification payments and bodily injury/tangible property damage. § 10 excludes consequential damages mutually and carves Customer's payment obligations out of that exclusion. That sits at/above the fallback (the $100,000 floor versus our preferred USD 1,000,000 floor is noted only).
- **Carve-outs fail the fallback.** Nothing takes breach of confidentiality/data-security, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud or IP infringement outside the cap. § 6 makes §§ 5, 9 and 10 override the AECI for confidential information in the hosting environment, and § 9.1(2) bars recovery for loss of or damage to Customer's records or data altogether.
- **Redline (validated ok:true):** a single new § 9.3 "Excluded Claims" inserted after § 9.2, disapplying the §§ 9.1, 9.2 and 10 limitations for those categories on a mutual basis — no rewrite of the existing sections.
